project_type: Flask web app - TikTok Downloader + Makima AI Chat (SPA with multiple views)
build_system: Docker/nixpacks for deployment, no build step for frontend (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS)
test_command: No test suite - validate by checking file syntax
verification_instructions: 1. Check Python syntax: python -c 'import app'. 2. Validate HTML well-formedness. 3. Verify CSS/JS have no syntax errors by reviewing structure.
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt (Flask, yt-dlp, google-generativeai, requests)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. No test suite exists. Validation is structural/syntactic only.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT touch downloader.js, photo.js, or any downloader-related logic. Do NOT hardcode API keys. Do NOT expose API keys to frontend. Do NOT create/generate images. Do NOT add new asset files.
key_patterns: SPA navigation via ui.js navigateTo(). Makima AI renders into #viewMakimaAI container. All AI UI in makima-ai.css + makima-ai.js. CSS variables defined in variables.css. Version string pattern: 20260528_N used across all CSS/JS refs in index.html.
directory_structure: templates/index.html = single HTML page. static/css/ = split CSS files. static/js/ = split JS files. app.py = Flask backend. static/img/ = images (do not modify).
